papers.markingGuideNote: The scheme awards attempt marks of 2 for a 5-mark step. Deduct 3 for a mathematical error, or 1 for a numerical slip or minor misreading. A serious error that oversimplifies the task receives attempt marks only. Valid alternative methods are accepted. Do not deduct an error twice.
papers.boundaryReview: Q3(b)(i) the pair of flight times receives the first two 5-mark placements; their ratio has a separate final 5. Q3(b)(ii) the range and the alpha result receive 5 each; hence or otherwise allows alternative methods for that same result, not a finite answer-option pool. Q4(b)(i) all three force diagrams share one 5-mark placement. Q5(a)(i) and Q5(b)(i) the final paired speeds share a 5-mark placement and remain joint tasks. Q6(b)(ii) the maximum and minimum tensions are intermediate steps toward the single requested ratio k. No finite answer-option pools occur.
